name: components/markdown
description: A markdown rendering component with a plugin architecture and optional plugin packs for Mermaid diagrams, syntax highlighting, copy actions, KaTeX math, and SMILES chemical structures.
useCases: Render user-authored markdown content with consistent shadcn styling
Attach enhancement plugins such as code copy and diagram rendering
Display technical docs that include code fences and math formulas
Render chemistry-focused notes with SMILES notation support
